reviewer.role: independent T29 evidence, browser and screenshot reviewer

evidence.detail: Inventory for independent-review.json only; manifest.json and SHA256SUMS are excluded to avoid a circular hash.

decision.review: The exact current-source author packet is internally consistent and independently rechecked in the retained evidence plus a focused Firefox repeat.

limits: The independent reviewer parsed the retained 1,137-case result rather than rerunning the complete matrix; the prescribed focused Firefox six-case repeat was independently rerun 18/18 across three repetitions.

The reviewed Axe attachments retain incomplete color-contrast and custom-element aria-controls diagnostics; there are zero retained Axe violations, and the diagnostics are disclosed as a nonblocking P2 rather than treated as compliance proof.
No manual VoiceOver, NVDA or other assistive-technology certification was performed or claimed.
The retained visual captures prove the owned fixtures and states, not universal pixel equivalence for every consumer environment or operating system.
The adverse timing report is a desktop Chromium observation and does not establish a universal performance threshold or field behavior.
This review does not qualify T30, T31, T40, publication, deployment, release promotion or live-site identity.
